prompt: Down the full length of a British market-town high street at night: every shop has its shutters down, and in every single doorway, all the way to the vanishing point, someone is sleeping in a sleeping bag, a few candles and lanterns, wet pavement. Winter night in a near-future Britain, the streetlights dead, lit only by braziers, camping lanterns and the glow of the city's towers; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
